stages.headline: A and A₁ are symmetric about line a if a is the perpendicular bisector of AA₁; a figure is symmetric about a if every point's image also belongs to it.
stages.headlineEnglish: A and A₁ are symmetric about line a if a is the perpendicular bisector of AA₁; a figure is symmetric about a if every point's image also belongs to it.

stages.headline: A and A₁ are symmetric about point O if O is the midpoint of AA₁; e.g. a parallelogram is centrally symmetric about its diagonals' crossing.
stages.headlineEnglish: A and A₁ are symmetric about point O if O is the midpoint of AA₁; e.g. a parallelogram is centrally symmetric about its diagonals' crossing.

stages.headline: Examples: a rectangle has 2 axes of symmetry, a square 4, a circle infinitely many.
stages.headlineEnglish: Examples: a rectangle has 2 axes of symmetry, a square 4, a circle infinitely many.
